s: [s] klI, (eti gacCati prAyaScittena । iR AgasItyasun nuqAgamaSca .) pApam । aparADaH । iti medinI ॥ nindA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (“enonivfttendriyavfttirenam jagAda BUyo jagadekanATaH ॥ iti raGuH । 5 । 23 ॥)
m: 1. एन a pronom. base (used for certain cases of the 3rd personal pronoun, thus in the acc. sing. du. pl. [एनम्, एनाम्, एनद्, &c.], inst. sing. [एनेन, एनया] gen. loc. du. [एनयोस्, Ved. एनोस्]; the other cases are formed fr. the pronom. base अ See under इदम्), he, she, it

this, that, (this pronoun is enclitic and cannot begin a sentence; it is generally used alone, so that एनम् पुरुषम्, ‘that man’, would be very unusual if not incorrect. Grammarians assert that the substitution of एनम् &c. for इमम् or एतम् &c. takes place when something is referred to which has already been mentioned in a previous part of the sentence; see Gr. 223 and 836)
एन [cf. Gk. ἕν, οἷος; Goth. ains; Old Pruss. ains; Lat. oinos, unus.]
2. एन and एना, Ved. instr. of इदम्, q.v.
3. एन (cf. एण), a stag. See अन्-एन.
